questions.text: Who is named alongside Paul as our brother in the opening salutation?

options.text: Luke the evangelist
Timothy our brother
Barnabas the apostle
Silas the fellowlabourer

questions.text: How does Paul describe God in the opening doxology of the first chapter?

options.text: Judge of the worlds and ruler over life and death
Creator of the universe and preserver of all things
The Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort
King of kings and sovereign over all principalities

questions.text: Wherefore does God comfort believers in all their tribulation?

options.text: That they might live in ease and experience no earthly trouble
That they might attain great riches and deliver themselves from poverty
That they might gain worldly honour and be esteemed by all men
That we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble

questions.text: What are all the promises of God in Jesus Christ according to Paul?

options.text: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen
In him are the law and the word
In him are the light and the life

questions.text: Why did Paul delay his coming unto Corinth according to his solemn oath?

options.text: Through fear of adversaries in Corinth

Because he lacked money for the journey
Because he preferred to remain at Troas

questions.text: How should the church receive the sorrowful offender who was rebuked by many?

options.text: Punish him and cast him out of the church, that he may truly repent and learn
Shun him and condemn him, that he may at last know his fault and repent

options.text: Lest the man should leave the city and fall among the heathen elsewhere
Lest the church should suffer harm through the discord of the brethren
Lest the law should be broken and the wickedness go unpunished

questions.text: In what city had Paul no rest in his spirit because he found not Titus?

At Athens, on the hill of the Areopagus

questions.text: What are the faithful ministers of the gospel declared to be unto God?

options.text: A royal priesthood ruling all earthly nations
For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ
A council of wise philosophers in Greek cities

options.text: He selleth the doctrine for money and maketh merchandise of the gospel
He preacheth his own wisdom and setteth it forth as the word of God
As of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God speak we in Christ

options.text: A writing of the high council that sheweth him to be a messenger

A seal of Caesar that giveth him authority for his ministry

options.text: Not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart
Upon tables of stone from Sinai
Upon parchment rolls in the sanctuary

options.text: The letter helpeth unto life, but the spirit hurteth man

options.text: The written letter
The fear of judgment
Silence in the temple

questions.text: What treasure do believers carry in earthen vessels according to 2 Corinthians 4:6-7?

The god of this world hath blinded them
The scribes and doctors of Jerusalem

Before the local elders of the church
Before the judgment seat of Christ

He shall never experience physical death, but abide perpetually in the flesh
He understandeth all the scrolls of the law and expoundeth them blamelessly

The collection of civil imperial taxes
The presentation of temple sacrifices

options.text: He preserved him from physical death and delivered him alive out of the tomb

options.text: In worldly wealth, earthly honor, and temporal power among all the citizens

options.text: Ye are a temporary building made of wood and stones
For ye are the temple of the living God, as God said

options.text: Build a fortress in the desert and dwell there in complete isolation
Refuse meat and water unto the Gentiles and avoid their table fellowship

options.text: God, that comforteth those that are cast down, comforted us by the coming of Titus

options.text: Godly sorrow bringeth poverty, while worldly sorrow gaineth silver and goods

Godly sorrow worketh repentance to salvation: but the sorrow of the world worketh death

Lack of brotherly charity, indifference, and contemptuous pride toward Paul

options.text: The abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto riches of liberality

options.text: They gathered money among the heathen

They built a great house
They fasted forty days

options.text: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men

questions.text: What manner of giver does God love according to the clear words in chapter 9?

options.text: God loveth a sorrowful giver
God loveth a rich giver
For God loveth a cheerful giver
God loveth a proud giver

questions.text: What is God able to bestow upon the generous giver in abundant measure?

options.text: Length of days without any sickness, sorrow, or infirmity in advanced old age
Preservation from all military foes and peace in all the cities of the country
Chief seats of honour in the marketplace and high esteem before civil princes

Increase the gold of the church, that it may help the poor

With subtle philosophical disputations borrowed from Athens

options.text: Only the devices of the rulers of the world that are set against the faithful

options.text: They ask God for his judgment and order themselves according to his word

options.text: Let the rich man glory in his silver and great wealth

options.text: They are of the house of Judah, out of which the king came forth

options.text: Riches, honour and esteem among men, and great power

options.text: Unto the third heaven

Unto the seventh heaven
Unto the heaven of the clouds

options.text: The peace of Rome, the wisdom of Greece, and the dominion of the Caesar be with you
